description: This file defines the BedrockDataAutomationClient class in the Aws\BedrockDataAutomation namespace. It extends AwsClient and provides method annotations for interacting with the Amazon Bedrock Data Automation service, including creating, deleting, updating, and listing blueprints and projects, both synchronously and asynchronously.

classes.name: BedrockDataAutomationClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with the Amazon Bedrock Data Automation service, extending the AwsClient base class.

methods.name: createBlueprint
methods.description: Creates a new blueprint in the service.

methods.name: createBlueprintAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new blueprint.

methods.name: createBlueprintVersion
methods.description: Creates a new version of an existing blueprint.

methods.name: createBlueprintVersionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new version of an existing blueprint.

methods.name: createDataAutomationProject
methods.description: Creates a new data automation project.

methods.name: createDataAutomationProjectAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new data automation project.

methods.name: deleteBlueprint
methods.description: Deletes an existing blueprint.

methods.name: deleteBlueprintAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a blueprint.

methods.name: deleteDataAutomationProject
methods.description: Deletes an existing data automation project.

methods.name: deleteDataAutomationProjectAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a data automation project.

methods.name: getBlueprint
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specified blueprint.

methods.name: getBlueprintAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves details of a blueprint.

methods.name: getDataAutomationProject
methods.description: Retrieves details of a data automation project.

methods.name: getDataAutomationProjectAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves details of a data automation project.

methods.name: listBlueprints
methods.description: Lists all blueprints.

methods.name: listBlueprintsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists all blueprints.

methods.name: listDataAutomationProjects
methods.description: Lists all data automation projects.

methods.name: listDataAutomationProjectsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists all data automation projects.

methods.name: updateBlueprint
methods.description: Updates an existing blueprint.

methods.name: updateBlueprintAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously updates a blueprint.

methods.name: updateDataAutomationProject
methods.description: Updates a data automation project.

methods.name: updateDataAutomationProjectAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously updates a data automation project.
